name: Reclaimed Treasures
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Sweeping the bat pens with this broom is not befitting a Garrett!  I've earned a little coin from this accursed job, and I'm willing to spend it on you to better my station.

The Garrett family weapon of choice is locked away in our chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman from when we Garretts toiled there as diggers.  Without it, I will be stuck here forever - literally - sweeping up after these infernal bats.

Reclaim my family's treasure and bring it to me!  Help me restore my birthright!
narrative.objectives: Get Patrick Garrett's family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
At last - a broom worthy of a Garrett.  You're bloody well worth every silver I spent on you, I say!

Do you hear me, foul bats?  I now wield the Garrett family weapon of choice!  Tremble, bats, tremble!!
narrative.requestItemsText: The sweeping never ends... these bats are prolific in their mockery of me and my broom.  Please tell me you've reclaimed my family's treasure!  I've offered you my silver - is that not enough?!
